# audio/ — Canned WAV Fallbacks

**Owner:** Suyog (P1)  
**Generated by:** `python voice/eleven.py`

## What lives here

| File | Spoken content | Used when |
|---|---|---|
| `goals_ok.wav` | "Got both. Send the email first — that's the short one. Then you have a straight run at senior design until 10." | ElevenLabs TTS unavailable during `/voice` response |
| `off_task.wav` | "You have senior design until 10. You can play after that. You'll regret this block later — go back to the project." | ElevenLabs TTS unavailable during `/coach` response |

## Why canned files exist

ElevenLabs or Wi-Fi may flake during judging. The backend falls back to these files so Buddy always speaks — even offline.

## How to regenerate

```bash
python voice/eleven.py
```

Overwrites both files. Requires `ELEVENLABS_API_KEY` in environment.

## Tonight exit
